name.description:
If no fields are populated on the Genai.LlmGuardrails.Processor, it will not be correctly persisted on
{@link Genai.LlmGuardrails.Manager#inputProcessors} or {@link Genai.LlmGuardrails.Manager#outputProcessors},
so this field exists to ensure that all processors are correctly persisted.

promptParamsToScan.description: The values of {@link Genai.Prompt#params} to scan.

threshold.description:
Threshold for detecting prompt injection. LLM Guard uses threshold values to evaluate the risk score of text inputs being scanned.
This numeric parameter sets the sensitivity level for detecting unwanted content, such as prompt injections.
The default threshold value provided by LLM Guard, based on industry standards, is 0.5.
For more details, please refer to https://llm-guard.com/get_started/quickstart/.

matchType.description: How to search for prompt injection in the input: within each chunk, each sentence, or across the entire input

title:
Note: The {@link Genai.LlmGuardrails.Processor.PromptInjection} guardrail is currently in beta and is not recommended for production use.
An input processor guardrail for performing Prompt Injection, which prevents security vulnerability specific to AI language models that occurs
when malicious inputs manipulate the model's behavior in unintended ways. Implementing an input processor guardrail can help mitigate the risk
of prompt injection by filtering and validating user inputs before they are processed.
name: Genai.LlmGuardrails.Processor.PromptInjection
